audit.whatIsWrong: The ability is called 'Powder Kegs' in winCon, the cooldown block, focus.text and the interactions row. Riot's name is Powder Keg, singular. Remove Scurvy is named but only half described.
audit.why: Riot's Remove Scurvy text: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health' — 22/20/18/16/14. It does not merely 'cleanse your W-stun setup', it cures the stun and heals him in the same button, which is why an all-in opened on an up Scurvy loses twice. Riot's Powder Keg is a placed keg at 1000 range that spreads his attack's damage when he shoots it.
audit.corrected: Powder Keg singular throughout; Remove Scurvy stated as a 22s cure-plus-heal to bait before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage is described as letting him 'farm and shove safely from range'. Two properties that matter more are absent.
audit.why: It is global at 30000 range on 160/140/120, and the kit flags true damage on it — so it is not a farming tool you can outrange, it is map pressure that answers your Grand Starfall roam, and stacking resistances does nothing about it. _missing-interactions.json flags the same resistance bypass.
audit.corrected: Cannon Barrage stated as a 160s global with true damage, traded against your own 180s roam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Coverage flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — no number appears in the matchup at all.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy 22s at rank 1, Parrrley 4.5s at 625, Powder Keg placed at 1000 range, Cannon Barrage 160s. Against Shield Vault's 600 range and 13s, the two numbers that decide the lane are the keg's 1000 outranging your gap-close and Scurvy's 22s being long enough to bait.
audit.corrected: Ranges and cooldowns now in the spikes, wants, early, mid, cooldown block and interactions row.

audit.why: 47.96% over 1566 games is a losing lane and the chart is honest about where: Pantheon takes levels 2-3, Gangplank takes everything once kegs chain. The item rows reading Pantheon is generous but defensible given the roam value of Grand Starfall.

edits.after: Shield Vault's 600-range leap-stun plus a tap Q wins level 1 — look for the level-2 all-in before Powder Keg chains and while Remove Scurvy is unranked.

edits.after: Cannon Barrage is global on 160s and deals true damage — he farms and shoves from anywhere, and its slow blunts your W approach.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your only clean window, so press them. At level 1 your point-and-click Shield Vault (W) stun plus a tap Q deals real damage before he has any barrels down, and at level 2 a W-Q all-in catches him while his barrel chain is still one keg. Hold-aim your long Q only to deny barrel last-hits — don't walk into auto range to throw it. Bait his Remove Scurvy (W): if he burns it to cleanse, your next W-stun lands clean.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your only clean window, so press them. At level 1 Shield Vault's 600-range leap-stun plus a tap Q deals real damage before a keg is down, and at level 2 the all-in catches him while the chain is still one keg. Hold-aim the long Comet Spear only to deny keg last-hits; do not walk into Parrrley's 625 to throw it. Bait Remove Scurvy — it cures the stun AND heals, so its 22 seconds is the window.

edits.before: By 4-5 he stabilizes — his barrel chains start one-shotting the wave and poking you from out of W range, and you have no sustain to eat it. Use Aegis Assault (E) to advance through a barrel detonation head-on, then W-Q, but don't all-in into a kept Scurvy. At 6 his Cannon Barrage (R) lets him farm safely and slow your gap-close, so your kill pressure dips even as your R opens roams to other lanes.
edits.after: By 4-5 he stabilizes — kegs sit at 1000, well outside Shield Vault's 600, and you have no sustain to eat the chain. Face a detonation so Aegis Assault takes it head-on, then W-Q, but never all-in into a held Remove Scurvy. At 6 Cannon Barrage is global on 160s and deals true damage, so it both farms for him and answers the roam your own 180s ultimate wanted to make.

notes: The lane's real sequencing rule was never on the page: Remove Scurvy is a 22-second button that CURES the stun and heals in one cast, so an all-in opened while it is up spends Shield Vault for nothing and pays for his sustain. Bait it, then commit — that is the whole matchup and the coverage report's 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice' flag was pointing straight at it. Also worth the user's attention: Cannon Barrage's kit flags include true damage, which makes the standard 'stack resistances into his scaling' instinct wrong; the Itemization row still reads generically and I had no string with room to restate it.
